description: IWEPS WalStat - parc de véhicules, immatriculations et voitures par ménage is a group of related datasets listed in Open Data Wallonie Bruxelles, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by IWEPS WalStat. Cette statistique donne un aperçu de tous les véhicules motorisés d’occasion, immatriculés en Belgique auprès du Service d’immatriculation de véhicules du SPF Mobilité pour une période donnée. Types de véhicule concernés: voitures de tourisme, autobus et autocars, camions, tracteurs routiers,. Coverage: Wallonia and Brussels. The portal lists 4 related datasets of one publisher (copies, years or sister lists), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under Administration et Services publics, Mobilité. Its keywords are mobilité, immatriculation, occasion, véhicule, motoriser, statistiques. The portal shows 287 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons - CC0 (http://www.opendefinition.org/licenses/cc-by/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-odwb-be-portal.
